manual.title: Bomb disposal manual
manual.intro: Every bomb is different. Read only the pages you hold out loud.
sharedRules: The defuser sees the bomb but not the manual. Specialists see the manual but not the bomb.
Three strikes blow the bomb. A solved module stays solved.
The serial number and the battery count matter in several rules.

wires.title: Wires
wires.intro: Cut exactly one wire. Read the rules for the number of wires shown, from top to bottom, and stop at the first one that applies.
rules4: More than one red wire and the last digit of the serial is odd → cut the last red wire.
The last wire is yellow and there are no red wires → cut the first wire.
Exactly one blue wire → cut the first wire.
More than one yellow wire → cut the fourth wire.
rules5: The last wire is black and the last digit of the serial is odd → cut the fourth wire.
Exactly one red wire and more than one yellow wire → cut the first wire.
No black wires → cut the second wire.
rules6: No yellow wires and the last digit of the serial is odd → cut the third wire.
Exactly one yellow wire and more than one white wire → cut the fourth wire.
No red wires → cut the last wire.
wires.note: “Last wire” means the rightmost wire as the defuser sees it.

button.title: The button
button.intro: Find the first rule that matches. PRESS means tap once. HOLD means keep it down until the manual tells you to release.
rules: Blue button with label ABORT → hold.
More than one battery and label DETONATE → press.
White button and the serial has a vowel → hold.
More than two batteries and the serial has no vowel → press.
Red button with label HOLD → press.
button.releaseIntro: While the defuser holds the button, a colored strip appears. Release when the timer shows the matching digit.
releaseRules: Blue strip → release when the timer shows 4.
White strip → release when the timer shows 1.
Yellow strip → release when the timer shows 5.
Red strip → release when the timer shows 7.
button.releaseWarning: Releasing too quickly or at the wrong moment is a strike.

keypad.title: Keypad
keypad.intro: The defuser sees four symbols. Find the single column below that contains all four, then press them in this order, from top to bottom of that column.
keypad.warning: One wrong symbol resets the entry and costs a strike.
